title: Suspected Drunk Driver Slams Into Virginia Deputy During Traffic Stop: Sheriff (PHOTOS) - NewsBreak
text:
By Zak Failla ,
13 hours ago
One night after helping someone in need, a Virginia deputy suddenly needed some help of his own.
Deputy St. Onge was conducting a traffic stop in Culpeper County on Tuesday, Aug. 25, when his vehicle was struck by a suspected impaired driver, according to the Culpeper County Sheriff's Office.
The crash left both vehicles with heavy damage, photos released by the sheriff's office show.
A suspected drunk driver struck a sheriff's deputy in Virginia.
Culpeper County SheriffThe front end and hood of a white car were crushed in the collision, while the marked sheriff's SUV sustained significant damage around its rear passenger side.
Despite the wreckage, nobody was injured, according to the sheriff's office.
The driver accused of striking St. Onge was taken into custody. Officials did not immediately release the driver's name or announce any charges.
The sheriff's office noted that St. Onge had been helping "someone in need" just one night earlier before finding himself on the receiving end of a frightening roadside encounter.
A suspected drunk driver struck a sheriff's deputy in Virginia.
Culpeper County SheriffThe circumstances surrounding the crash, including what led up to it, were not immediately released.
"This incident has hit multiple pages already; therefore, we felt the info needed to be shared," the sheriff's office said while announcing the crash.
The investigation remained active Wednesday night, and officials said additional updates would be released as the incident progresses.
Check Daily Voice for updates.
